How it works

1. Allow the floating overlay.
2. Start screen capture and approve Android’s prompt.
3. Keep the card suit glyph visible in the target game.
4. Replace the starter templates in app/src/main/assets/templates with tight grayscale crops from that game for reliable matching.

The app only counts matches after two consistent frames and applies a short cooldown so one card is not counted repeatedly.
